newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss September trade data due on Oct 15. [CORRECTED 15:42 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Swiss September trade data due on Oct 15. [CORRECTED 15:42 GMT]

text.p: Switzerland's balance of trade data for September will be released on Tuesday (corrects day from Monday) at 0615 GMT, the Federal Customs Office said on Friday.
Revised figures for August provided by the office showed a surplus of 6.3 million Swiss francs, reflecting imports of 6,201.5 million and exports of 6,207.8 million francs.
These figures excluded precious metals, precious stones, art objects and antiques.
Preliminary August data released on September 16 showed a surplus of 11.1 million Swiss francs, imports of 6,187.7 million and exports of 6,198.8 million. - Zurich Newsroom +41-1-631 7340
